checked_classes: Spec violations — checked each acceptance criterion against the added agent files, repo-resident skill files, documented prerequisites, and smoke evidence; the required agents, frontmatter fields, skill placement, ownership/rules, verification commands, and smoke answers are present in the diff.
Correctness — checked for internally contradictory agent instructions or malformed task coverage in the changed markdown/YAML frontmatter; no concrete defect is evident from the packet.

Regressions — checked for modifications to existing production code, generated files, schema, store/search behavior, handler interfaces, or tests; the diff only adds agent/docs/orchestrator files and an OpenSpec task file.
Security — checked for hardcoded credentials/DSNs, PHI-like data, unsafe command guidance, or tenant/RLS weakening; no secret or PHI-bearing production change is present.

Constraint breaches — checked blocking constraints that apply to this diff, including no Go files requiring license/gofmt, no resource_json GIN/schema changes, no store/handler/index/db changes triggering race integration gate, and no generated/golden file edits.

Silent failure — checked for instructions that swallow verification failures or permit marking tasks done despite failed checks; the agent prompts require reporting real command outcomes and not marking failed work done.
